s0001.literal: Second month, on gengshen day the Scripture Printing Intendant Office was established.
s0001.idiomatic: Second month, on gengshen day the Scripture Printing Intendant Office was established.

s0002.literal: On wuchen day Daning Route suffered an earthquake.
s0002.idiomatic: On wuchen day Daning Route suffered an earthquake.

s0003.literal: On guiyou day Mars transgressed Eastern Well.
s0003.idiomatic: On guiyou day Mars transgressed Eastern Well.

s0004.literal: On jiaxu day attendant censor Zhao Shiyan was made associate administrator of the central secretariat.
s0004.idiomatic: On jiaxu day attendant censor Zhao Shiyan was made associate administrator of the central secretariat.

s0005.literal: An edict exempted land tax in Mongol territory for two years; merchants were not exempted.
s0005.idiomatic: An edict exempted land tax in Mongol territory for two years; merchants were not exempted.

s0006.literal: On jimao day six thousand three hundred ingots of notes were issued to relieve the relay stations of Liangxiang and others.
s0006.idiomatic: On jimao day 6,300 ingots of notes were issued to relieve the relay stations of Liangxiang and others.

s0007.literal: On renwu day Hesan was made right chancellor of the central secretariat and compiler of the national history.
s0007.idiomatic: On renwu day Hesan was made right chancellor of the central secretariat and compiler of the national history.

s0008.literal: On guiwei day central secretariat associate administrator Gao Fang was made Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies.
s0008.idiomatic: On guiwei day central secretariat associate administrator Gao Fang was made Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies.

s0009.literal: Third month, on renchen day the moon obscured Mars.
s0009.idiomatic: Third month, on renchen day the moon obscured Mars.

s0010.literal: Prince Tashih was granted one thousand ingots of Mongol notes and two suits of clothing.
s0010.idiomatic: Prince Tashih was granted 1,000 ingots of Mongol notes and two suits of clothing.

s0011.literal: On wuxu day the people of Zhending, Baoding, and Hejian suffered famine; grain for two months was issued.
s0011.idiomatic: On wuxu day the people of Zhending, Baoding, and Hejian suffered famine; grain for two months was issued.

s0012.literal: On jihai day a white halo spanned heaven, linked rings piercing the sun.
s0012.idiomatic: On jihai day a white halo spanned heaven, linked rings piercing the sun.

s0013.literal: On guimao day the king of Siam dispatched his minister Aitan to enter tribute.
s0013.idiomatic: On guimao day the king of Siam dispatched his minister Aitan to enter tribute.

s0014.literal: Nanjian Route was renamed Yanping; Jianpu County was renamed Nanping.
s0014.idiomatic: Nanjian Route was renamed Yanping; Jianpu County was renamed Nanping.

s0015.literal: On yisi day, because monks performed Buddhist rites to select prisoners for release, the central secretariat was ordered to examine the matter.
s0015.idiomatic: On yisi day, because monks performed Buddhist rites to select prisoners for release, the central secretariat was ordered to examine the matter.

s0016.literal: On bingwu day Arghun was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.
s0016.idiomatic: On bingwu day Arghun was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.

s0017.literal: On wushen day the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.
s0017.idiomatic: On wushen day the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.

s0018.literal: On jiyou day an edict: "Wicked commoners who castrate their sons as palace eunuchs to evade corvée shall be punished.
s0018.idiomatic: On jiyou day an edict directed, "Wicked commoners who castrate their sons as palace eunuchs to evade corvée shall be punished.

s0019.literal: " On xinhai day associate administrator Zhao Shiyan was ordered to take overall charge of the National University.
s0019.idiomatic: " On xinhai day associate administrator Zhao Shiyan was ordered to take overall charge of the National University.

s0020.literal: On guichou day central secretariat grand councillor Chaghan retired from office.
s0020.idiomatic: On guichou day central secretariat grand councillor Chaghan retired from office.

s0021.literal: The people of Jinning, Hou Xier and his five brothers, were all by law liable to death; the Emperor sighed and said: "That household was unfortunate to have this matter; let one of lighter culpability be chosen and beaten with the rod, so he may support his parents and their sacrificial line not be cut off."
s0021.idiomatic: The people of Jinning, Hou Xier and his five brothers, were all by law liable to death; the Emperor sighed and said, "That household was unfortunate to have this matter; let one of lighter culpability be chosen and beaten with the rod, so he may support his parents and their sacrificial line not be cut off."

s0022.literal: Intercalary third month, on jiayin new moon an edict reduced redundant posts among privy council vice directors.
s0022.idiomatic: Intercalary third month, on jiayin new moon an edict reduced redundant posts among privy council vice directors.

s0023.literal: On xinyou day the moon transgressed Ghost.
s0023.idiomatic: On xinyou day the moon transgressed Ghost.

s0024.literal: Monthly stipends to incantation monks were abolished.
s0024.idiomatic: Monthly stipends to incantation monks were abolished.

s0025.literal: Men were dispatched to inspect the halting encampment grounds from Dadu to the Upper Capital; where civilian fields had been encroached upon, compensation per mu was calculated and paid.
s0025.idiomatic: Men were dispatched to inspect the halting encampment grounds from Dadu to the Upper Capital; where civilian fields had been encroached upon, compensation per mu was calculated and paid.

s0026.literal: On bingyin day the moon transgressed the Eastern Rampart of Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0026.idiomatic: On bingyin day the moon transgressed the Eastern Rampart of Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0027.literal: On dingchou day the capital region and garrison-farm troops of the various guards suffered famine; seven thousand five hundred ingots of notes were issued for relief.
s0027.idiomatic: On dingchou day the capital region and garrison-farm troops of the various guards suffered famine; 7,500 ingots of notes were issued for relief.

s0028.literal: Bianliang, Jining, Dongchang and other routes; Long Prefecture and Kai Prefecture; Qingcheng, Qidong, Weiyuan, Dongming, Changyuan and other counties — frost killed mulberry trees, fruit trees, and seedlings; Guizhou reported famine; grain was issued and sold at reduced price for relief.
s0028.idiomatic: Bianliang, Jining, Dongchang and other routes; Long Prefecture and Kai Prefecture; Qingcheng, Qidong, Weiyuan, Dongming, Changyuan and other counties — frost killed mulberry trees, fruit trees, and seedlings; Guizhou reported famine; grain was issued and sold at reduced price for relief.

s0029.literal: The king of Ma'bar, Siramaldin, dispatched his minister Aisiding to present local products.
s0029.idiomatic: The king of Ma'bar, Siramaldin, dispatched his minister Aisiding to present local products.

s0030.literal: Fifth month, on jiayin new moon Prince of Ying Yesian Temür was granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
s0030.idiomatic: Fifth month, on jiayin new moon Prince of Ying Yesian Temür was granted 10,000 ingots of notes.

s0031.literal: On wuwu day Mercury transgressed Ghost.
s0031.idiomatic: On wuwu day Mercury transgressed Ghost.

s0032.literal: On dingmao day Li Meng was granted twenty-eight qing of land in Xiaogan County.
s0032.idiomatic: On dingmao day Li Meng was granted 28 qing of land in Xiaogan County.

s0033.literal: Princes' collateral branches were forbidden to directly seize apportioned-fief rent and levies to harass the people.
s0033.idiomatic: Princes' collateral branches were forbidden to directly seize apportioned-fief rent and levies to harass the people.

s0034.literal: An edict directed the Lingbei branch secretariat to bury battlefield remains.
s0034.idiomatic: An edict directed the Lingbei branch secretariat to bury battlefield remains.

s0035.literal: On yihai day three thousand shi of grain were issued to relieve the destitute of Qielolian.
s0035.idiomatic: On yihai day 3,000 shi of grain were issued to relieve the destitute of Qielolian.

s0036.literal: On dingchou day Cangzhou's seat of government was moved to Changlu Fort.
s0036.idiomatic: On dingchou day Cangzhou's seat of government was moved to Changlu Fort.

s0037.literal: On wuyin day, for the former Confucian minister Xu Heng, the Lu Studio Academy was established at Jingzhao; an imperial letter was sent down to honor him.
s0037.idiomatic: On wuyin day, for the former Confucian minister Xu Heng, the Lu Studio Academy was established at Jingzhao; an imperial letter was sent down to honor him.

s0038.literal: On gengchen day Luyang and Mayang counties, because of bandit raids, had their land taxes and levies remitted.
s0038.idiomatic: On gengchen day Luyang and Mayang counties, because of bandit raids, had their land taxes and levies remitted.

s0039.literal: The impoverished collateral following of Prince of Ying Yesian Temür was relieved with grain for two months.
s0039.idiomatic: The impoverished collateral following of Prince of Ying Yesian Temür was relieved with grain for two months.

s0040.literal: Wuling County suffered heavy rain and water overflow; residents drowned, and dwellings and crops were washed away; the people of Tanzhou, Hanyang, and Sizhou suffered famine — in all cases granaries were opened and grain sold at reduced price for relief.
s0040.idiomatic: Wuling County suffered heavy rain and water overflow; residents drowned, and dwellings and crops were washed away; the people of Tanzhou, Hanyang, and Sizhou suffered famine — in all cases granaries were opened and grain sold at reduced price for relief.

s0041.literal: Fushi County suffered wind and hail, damaging crops and injuring people and livestock.
s0041.idiomatic: Fushi County suffered wind and hail, damaging crops and injuring people and livestock.

s0042.literal: Sixth month, on wuzi day an edict: "Henceforth inner attendants shall be granted only eunuch posts and not civil ranks.
s0042.idiomatic: Sixth month, on wuzi day an edict directed, "Henceforth inner attendants shall be granted only eunuch posts and not civil ranks.

s0043.literal: " The Yunnan Branch Secretariat Confucianism Intendant Office was established.
s0043.idiomatic: " The Yunnan Branch Secretariat Confucianism Intendant Office was established.

s0044.literal: Henan Province chancellor Bolinjidai was enfeoffed as Prince of Henan.
s0044.idiomatic: Henan Province chancellor Bolinjidai was enfeoffed as Prince of Henan.

s0045.literal: On renchen day one additional subprefect and registrar each were added for inner-circuit prefectures and counties.
s0045.idiomatic: On renchen day one additional subprefect and registrar each were added for inner-circuit prefectures and counties.

s0046.literal: Prince Chaba'er's dependent households were destitute; grain for one year was issued, and they were still ordered to garrison-farm for self-support.
s0046.idiomatic: Prince Chaba'er's dependent households were destitute; grain for one year was issued, and they were still ordered to garrison-farm for self-support.

s0047.literal: Troops were dispatched to expand garrison farming at Henan Shao Marsh and other places.
s0047.idiomatic: Troops were dispatched to expand garrison farming at Henan Shao Marsh and other places.

s0048.literal: On yiwei day Mars transgressed Right Enforcer.
s0048.idiomatic: On yiwei day Mars transgressed Right Enforcer.

s0049.literal: On wushen day one additional vice director was added to the Liang-Zhe Salt Transport Commission.
s0049.idiomatic: On wushen day one additional vice director was added to the Liang-Zhe Salt Transport Commission.

s0050.literal: On jiachen day the imperial letters exempting Hexi monks from rent and levies were confiscated.
s0050.idiomatic: On jiachen day the imperial letters exempting Hexi monks from rent and levies were confiscated.

s0051.literal: An edict: "Princes and imperial affines coming to court shall graze their herds to the Upper Capital in summer and not rashly enter the capital; if there is business, they shall dispatch envoys to memorialize and report.
s0051.idiomatic: An edict directed, "Princes and imperial affines coming to court shall graze their herds to the Upper Capital in summer and not rashly enter the capital; if there is business, they shall dispatch envoys to memorialize and report.

s0052.literal: " Hengzhou, Chenzhou, Xingguo, Yongzhou Route, and Leiyang Prefecture suffered famine; granaries were opened and grain sold at reduced price for relief.
s0052.idiomatic: " Hengzhou, Chenzhou, Xingguo, Yongzhou Route, and Leiyang Prefecture suffered famine; granaries were opened and grain sold at reduced price for relief.

s0053.literal: Xuanping, Renshou, and Baideng counties suffered hail damage to crops, injuring people and livestock.
s0053.idiomatic: Xuanping, Renshou, and Baideng counties suffered hail damage to crops, injuring people and livestock.

s0054.literal: Seventh month, autumn, on yimao day Dajinai's following was destitute; two shi of grain per household were issued.
s0054.idiomatic: Seventh month, autumn, on yimao day Dajinai's following was destitute; two shi of grain per household were issued.

s0055.literal: On gengwu day the central secretariat was ordered to deliberate on restoring posthumous enfeoffment; Prince of Jin Yesun Temür's following was granted one hundred thousand ingots of notes.
s0055.idiomatic: On gengwu day the central secretariat was ordered to deliberate on restoring posthumous enfeoffment; Prince of Jin Yesun Temür's following was granted 100,000 ingots of notes.

s0056.literal: An edict opened the prohibition on off-season maritime trade.
s0056.idiomatic: An edict opened the prohibition on off-season maritime trade.

s0057.literal: Prince Wei Amuge and others were granted seven thousand ingots of notes.
s0057.idiomatic: Prince Wei Amuge and others were granted 7,000 ingots of notes.

s0058.literal: On yihai day Huifu Court exceeded its authority in memorializing imperial decisions to appoint officials; an edict directed that from now on all nominees be submitted to the central secretariat for approval and report.
s0058.idiomatic: On yihai day Huifu Court exceeded its authority in memorializing imperial decisions to appoint officials; an edict directed that from now on all nominees be submitted to the central secretariat for approval and report.

s0059.literal: Private salt prohibitions were strictly enforced.
s0059.idiomatic: Private salt prohibitions were strictly enforced.

s0060.literal: Yuanling and Luxi counties suffered flooding; the Hun River dike burst at Wuqing County, inundating civilian fields; granaries were opened for relief.
s0060.idiomatic: Yuanling and Luxi counties suffered flooding; the Hun River dike burst at Wuqing County, inundating civilian fields; granaries were opened for relief.

s0061.literal: Eighth month, on wuzi day the imperial carriage reached Dadu.
s0061.idiomatic: Eighth month, on wuzi day the imperial carriage reached Dadu.

s0062.literal: On guimao day the Court of Imperial Sacrifices was raised to the Grand Ceremony Court, rank 2a.
s0062.idiomatic: On guimao day the Court of Imperial Sacrifices was raised to the Grand Ceremony Court, rank 2a.

s0063.literal: On dingwei day Jining, Bianliang, and Wu'an and She counties suffered earthquakes, destroying official and civilian dwellings; at Wu'an fourteen persons died, at She County three hundred twenty-six persons.
s0063.idiomatic: On dingwei day Jining, Bianliang, and Wu'an and She counties suffered earthquakes, destroying official and civilian dwellings; at Wu'an 14 persons died, at She County 326 persons.

s0064.literal: Taizhou, Yuezhou, Wugang, Changde, Daozhou and other routes suffered flooding; granaries were opened and grain sold at reduced price for relief.
s0064.idiomatic: Taizhou, Yuezhou, Wugang, Changde, Daozhou and other routes suffered flooding; granaries were opened and grain sold at reduced price for relief.

s0065.literal: Ninth month, on renxu day the intendant of the Teaching Workshop was changed to envoy.
s0065.idiomatic: Ninth month, on renxu day the intendant of the Teaching Workshop was changed to envoy.

s0066.literal: On jisi day Temüder was again made right chancellor; Hesan was made left chancellor.
s0066.idiomatic: On jisi day Temüder was again made right chancellor; Hesan was made left chancellor.

s0067.literal: The Shaanxi Branch Censorate was abolished; the Ceremonial Phoenix Commissioner was reduced to Ceremonial Phoenix envoy.
s0067.idiomatic: The Shaanxi Branch Censorate was abolished; the Ceremonial Phoenix Commissioner was reduced to Ceremonial Phoenix envoy.

s0068.literal: Zhaoqing, Wuchang, Jiande, Jiankang, Nankang, Jiangzhou, Yuanzhou, Jianchang, Ganzhou, Hangzhou, Fuzhou, Anfeng and other routes suffered flooding; granaries were opened and grain sold at reduced price for relief.
s0068.idiomatic: Zhaoqing, Wuchang, Jiande, Jiankang, Nankang, Jiangzhou, Yuanzhou, Jianchang, Ganzhou, Hangzhou, Fuzhou, Anfeng and other routes suffered flooding; granaries were opened and grain sold at reduced price for relief.

s0069.literal: Tenth month, winter, on guisi day Yingzhou Wanhu Office was raised to Central Wanhu Office.
s0069.idiomatic: Tenth month, winter, on guisi day Yingzhou Wanhu Office was raised to Central Wanhu Office.

s0070.literal: On yiwei day an edict: "When clerks and functionaries transfer to office, they shall stop at seventh rank; those awaiting selection shall be registered at reduced grade.
s0070.idiomatic: On yiwei day an edict directed, "When clerks and functionaries transfer to office, they shall stop at seventh rank; those awaiting selection shall be registered at reduced grade.

s0071.literal: " Prohibitions against inner attendants and other offices bypassing the central secretariat in memorializing and requesting were strictly enforced.
s0071.idiomatic: " Prohibitions against inner attendants and other offices bypassing the central secretariat in memorializing and requesting were strictly enforced.

s0072.literal: An edict: "Off-season merchant traders must obtain passes from the Jiang-Zhe province before departing; on return taxes shall be levied according to regulation; those who go privately shall have their goods confiscated.
s0072.idiomatic: An edict directed, "Off-season merchant traders must obtain passes from the Jiang-Zhe province before departing; on return taxes shall be levied according to regulation; those who go privately shall have their goods confiscated.

s0073.literal: " Officials were dispatched to register idle fields farmed by Huai region commoners on which no tax was paid.
s0073.idiomatic: " Officials were dispatched to register idle fields farmed by Huai region commoners on which no tax was paid.

s0074.literal: On bingshen day Gansu garrison farming was restored; the Shagu and other places garrison-store overall wanhu office was established, rank 3a.
s0074.idiomatic: On bingshen day Gansu garrison farming was restored; the Shagu and other places garrison-store overall wanhu office was established, rank 3a.

s0075.literal: On yisi day two tutors were established for Prince of Enping Tasibuhua.
s0075.idiomatic: On yisi day two tutors were established for Prince of Enping Tasibuhua.

s0076.literal: On gengxu day Mercury transgressed Eastern Glory.
s0076.idiomatic: On gengxu day Mercury transgressed Eastern Glory.

s0077.literal: A surveillance censor said: "We request that the privy council establish methods to drill soldiers; military officers inheriting posts should be tested in martial affairs before assuming duty.
s0077.idiomatic: A surveillance censor said, "We request that the privy council establish methods to drill soldiers; military officers inheriting posts should be tested in martial affairs before assuming duty.

s0079.literal: " Zhang Lü was dispatched to administer Jiangnan field tax and grain.
s0079.idiomatic: " Zhang Lü was dispatched to administer Jiangnan field tax and grain.

s0080.literal: Eleventh month, on renzi day the Directorate of Astronomy was raised to the Observatory of Astronomy, rank 3a; a silver seal was granted.
s0080.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on renzi day the Directorate of Astronomy was raised to the Observatory of Astronomy, rank 3a; a silver seal was granted.

s0081.literal: On yimao day the Datong Guard Personal Army Overall Command was changed to the Central Capital Weiguard Office.
s0081.idiomatic: On yimao day the Datong Guard Personal Army Overall Command was changed to the Central Capital Weiguard Office.

s0082.literal: The Bao'an Army was established at Mayang County to guard against Yao bandits.
s0082.idiomatic: The Bao'an Army was established at Mayang County to guard against Yao bandits.

s0083.literal: On wuchen day Communications Court commissioner Xiao Baizhu was made central secretariat right vice chancellor.
s0083.idiomatic: On wuchen day Communications Court commissioner Xiao Baizhu was made central secretariat right vice chancellor.

s0084.literal: On xinwei day Hanlin Academician Exemplar Dashman was made privy council administrator.
s0084.idiomatic: On xinwei day Hanlin Academician Exemplar Dashman was made privy council administrator.

s0085.literal: On guiyou day an edict: "Clerks and functionaries guilty of theft shall have their faces tattooed.
s0085.idiomatic: On guiyou day an edict directed, "Clerks and functionaries guilty of theft shall have their faces tattooed.

s0086.literal: " Daning Route suffered an earthquake, with a sound like thunder.
s0086.idiomatic: " Daning Route suffered an earthquake, with a sound like thunder.

s0087.literal: On wuyin day Temüder said: "Recently subordinates and ministers of the six ministries have all arrived late and left early; government affairs have been neglected.
s0087.idiomatic: On wuyin day Temüder said, "Recently subordinates and ministers of the six ministries have all arrived late and left early; government affairs have been neglected.

s0088.literal: From now on, where this occurs, they shall be beaten according to the gravity of the offense.
s0088.idiomatic: From now on, where this occurs, they shall be beaten according to the gravity of the offense.

s0089.literal: If we your ministers ourselves are indolent, others may also memorialize about it.
s0089.idiomatic: If we your ministers ourselves are indolent, others may also memorialize about it.

s0090.literal: " The Emperor said: "If they still do not reform, they shall be dismissed without reinstatement.
s0090.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "If they still do not reform, they shall be dismissed without reinstatement.

s0091.literal: " The former central secretariat right chancellor Tuhulu was made privy council administrator.
s0091.idiomatic: " The former central secretariat right chancellor Tuhulu was made privy council administrator.

s0092.literal: Jing'an Route suffered famine; grain was issued for relief.
s0092.idiomatic: Jing'an Route suffered famine; grain was issued for relief.

s0093.literal: An edict ordered verification of field taxes in Zhe West, Jiang East, and Jiangxi.
s0093.idiomatic: An edict ordered verification of field taxes in Zhe West, Jiang East, and Jiangxi.

s0094.literal: Twelfth month, on renwu day Bianliang, Nanyang, Guide, Runing, and Huai'an suffered flooding; an edict forbade brewing wine and added relief measures as appropriate.
s0094.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on renwu day Bianliang, Nanyang, Guide, Runing, and Huai'an suffered flooding; an edict forbade brewing wine and added relief measures as appropriate.

s0095.literal: On guiwei day Prince Temurbuqa's following was relieved with five thousand shi of grain; Prince Tuman's following with two thousand shi.
s0095.idiomatic: On guiwei day Prince Temurbuqa's following was relieved with 5,000 shi of grain; Prince Tuman's following with 2,000 shi.

s0096.literal: On xinmao day princes, imperial sons-in-law, and persons of power were forbidden to sell salt at inflated prices.
s0096.idiomatic: On xinmao day princes, imperial sons-in-law, and persons of power were forbidden to sell salt at inflated prices.

s0097.literal: On renchen day an edict fixed regulations for officials', gentry's, and commoners' clothing, carts, and palanquins.
s0097.idiomatic: On renchen day an edict fixed regulations for officials', gentry's, and commoners' clothing, carts, and palanquins.

s0098.literal: On jiawu day the moon transgressed Ghost.
s0098.idiomatic: On jiawu day the moon transgressed Ghost.

s0099.literal: On jihai day an edict directed the central secretariat to deliberate which of Confucius's fifty-third-generation descendants should inherit Duke Yansheng and report by name.
s0099.idiomatic: On jihai day an edict directed the central secretariat to deliberate which of Confucius's fifty-third-generation descendants should inherit Duke Yansheng and report by name.

s0100.literal: On gengzi day officials were dispatched to dredge the canals at Yangzhou, Huai'an, and other places; Hanlin Academician Exemplar Li Meng was again made central secretariat grand councillor.
s0100.idiomatic: On gengzi day officials were dispatched to dredge the canals at Yangzhou, Huai'an, and other places; Hanlin Academician Exemplar Li Meng was again made central secretariat grand councillor.
